<subject>Catherine Storey for Corporate Advisory Client Reviews</subject>
<body>
I spoke with each of you a couple of weeks ago, but this matter was sidelined due to more urgent issues. Still, everyone agreed that establishing a firm deadline would be reasonable for finalising client reviews in Corporate, Litigation, and Compliance.

The most practical approach is to set a daily cutoff at 4pm (to get a sense of volume, I checked yesterday’s activity to see how many reviews were completed after 4pm London time. There were three Corporate files and two Litigation matters). After 4pm, the system would automatically carry forward any pending client reviews to the next business day. However, for those cases that don’t automatically roll over after 4pm, the respective teams must remember these count as the following day’s workload. 

I’m uncertain how the Compliance reporting procedures might need adjusting, since the official daily records won’t reflect these late submissions. Could Compliance generate supplementary reports to ensure the teams have accurate statuses each morning?

Please send any feedback you have, and in any case, can you all confirm that a 4pm cutoff is workable for your teams?

Danielle  
x36557

Eric – do you foresee any issues with the Compliance reporting?  
Mary – we touched on this briefly a few weeks ago… any further thoughts?  
</body>
